title: Graphics Standards Manual
slide_intent: Establish who issued the manual and which identity it governs. A reader should recognize the document and distinguish its edition before using its specifications.
strategic_value: NASA can turn the cover into a first encounter with the system. The scale of the black logotype conveys its central place in the manual.
demonstration: The cover places the agency name, manual title, document number and January 1976 date in small type above a large black NASA logotype.
practical_value: Identify this handbook as NHB 1430.2 and use the date to distinguish this edition from later reproductions or policies.

content_islands.name: Publication details
content_islands.spec: Align the agency name and document title above the logotype. Place NHB 1430.2 and the date at the top right.

content_islands.name: Cover logotype
content_islands.spec: Set the black NASA mark on white below the header. Leave a deep unused field beneath it.
